steps.message: Quantos chamados estão em atendimento em Trairi?

oracle.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE status = 'Em atendimento' AND (LOWER(BTRIM(store_name)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Trairi')) OR LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Trairi')));
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM services WHERE status = 'Em atendimento' AND (LOWER(BTRIM(store_name)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Maracaçumé')) OR LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Maracaçumé')));
SELECT ticket FROM services WHERE status = 'Em atendimento' AND (LOWER(BTRIM(store_name)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Maracaçumé')) OR LOWER(BTRIM(praca)) = LOWER(BTRIM('Maracaçumé')));
